messages:
laura (marketing): ok team — finalizing run orders & backstage handoffs for next Thurs webinar. need a compact checklist and one-page cue map.

sam (events): +1. can we keep total live portion to 30m and 10m q&a? we should leave 5m for a quick product CTA demo.

diego (growth): topic suggestion landing well in tests: 'Practical inference tradeoffs: latency, cost, and rollouts' — but avoid heavy jargon in the title. maybe 'Serving LLMs in Production: Cost & Latency Tradeoffs'

nina (speaker-ops): noted. speaker lineup: laura to open (5m), alex for demo (10m), diego for benchmark narrative & cost story (8m), panel Q&A with alex+diego+laura (7m) — that totals 30.

laura (marketing): perfect. nina, can you create a 1-pager for each speaker with 3 key bullets to hit? one-sentence bold takeaways.

nina (speaker-ops): on it. I'll draft and ping speakers for approval. deadline EOD Tue.

alex (eng-demo): demo plan: live inference against hosted vs dedicated config, show token latency and cost numbers. need a clean fallback if cloud demo flakes. recommend a recorded clip as hot-swap.

sam (events): good call. plan: tech check at T-45, full run at T-24h. hot-swap plan: have recorded 3-min clip queued in StreamY.

laura (marketing): slots: tech-check 10:15am PT, full run 4:30pm PT day before. nina will coordinate with speakers for availability.

laura (marketing): quick run-of-show draft (please review):

```
00:00 - 00:30  Welcome + intro (laura)
00:30 - 10:30  Demo: latency vs cost (alex)
10:30 - 18:30  Benchmark & cost narrative (diego)
18:30 - 25:30  Product CTA + how to get started (laura)
25:30 - 30:00  Live Q&A (panel)
30:00 - 35:00  Post-webinar CTA + recording outro (laura)
```

laura (marketing): bold ask: diego, have two simple benchmark slides (one cost slide, one latency slide) + an appendix slide showing model variants & quantization settings.

diego (growth): will do. also adding a one-slide 'what to watch for' for attendees who care about production rollout patterns.

alex (eng-demo): question: where will we pull demo keys from? we should use a staging key with rate limits. also prefer a mock dataset to avoid customer PII.

nina (speaker-ops): use staging.redwood-demo key, I'll request rate limits from infra. mock dataset approved.

laura (marketing): lead routing: collect registrant checkbox for "interested in Dedicated capacity" and route to diego@redwood via HubSpot workflow. sam can you confirm webhook name?

sam (events): HubSpot webhook: hs-webinar-infer-2026. i'll test routing during full run.

laura (marketing): rehearsal logistics:
- T-45 tech check: all speakers on stage, audio/video + stream test
- T-24h full run: go through slide deck, transitions, hot-swap demo clip, and Q&A moderation practice
- T-60m pre-show: final brief + attendee intro slide queued

nina (speaker-ops): mic rules: speakers on mute until cued, use wired headphones if possible, and keep phones on silent. backstage chat will be Slack thread only.

alex (eng-demo): can we add a simple fallback policy line in slides: "If demo latency > 2s, switch to recorded clip" — i can script an audio cue.

laura (marketing): love that. diego, add a short 'how to interpret the numbers' voiceover for 1 slide — helps non-technical audience.

diego (growth): copy for the slide incoming. also recommending one tweetable headline per speaker for live social.

sam (events): stream team ask: please add captions live and save separate recorded asset for demo clip.

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: "Webinar — Serving LLMs in Prod: Cost & Latency" at 2026-05-12T17:00:00Z (organizer: laura).

laura (marketing): final checklist before EOD Tue:
- nina: speaker one-pagers
- alex: demo hot-swap clip & cue script
- diego: slides + one-line soundbites
- sam: verify HubSpot webhook + captions
- laura: social draft + CTAs

nina (speaker-ops): tagging speakers now. will open separate DM threads for quick approvals.

laura (marketing): thanks all — this thread is our backstage source of truth. ping here for any last-minute swaps. :raised_hands:
